blocks.text: Why you pay EMI for 5 years but your loan amount barely drops.

For a fully amortising loan, the interest and principal shares of each EMI depend on the rate, balance, and remaining term. Early payments often contain more interest, but there is no universal percentage.
Illustration: ₹10 lakh loan, 9% annual rate, 20-year term

The Fix: Making an extra payment can reduce principal and may shorten the loan or lower future EMIs, depending on the lender’s rules and how the payment is applied. Use the calculator with your actual rate, balance, and payment schedule.

summary: Why your EMI barely dents the principal in year one — and the one prepayment habit that fixes it.
title: The EMI Trap
